UGC NET Exam Dates and DU PhD Admissions Announced

Applications have opened for the UGC NET December 2026 examination, with the deadline set for October 28. Separately, admissions for PhD programs at Delhi University (DU) for 2026 are also open, and applications must be submitted by October 18. Admission to DU's PhD programs will be based on the UGC NET exam.
